# Packetly

> Free cheat sheets for IT, cybersecurity and network engineers. Inspection commands for Windows, Active Directory, Entra ID, Azure, FortiGate, Cisco, Juniper, Sophos, Ubiquiti, HPE, Dell and Linux, each with a plain-English walkthrough.

Packetly publishes 82 command references for IT, cybersecurity and network engineers. Each sheet pairs a command with what it inspects and how to interpret the output, and links to the vendor documentation it is based on. Content is editorial, not vendor certification material.

## Cheat sheets

### [Cloud cheat sheets](https://packetly.ly/topics/cloud/)

Cloud references for Azure, AWS, Kubernetes and Terraform: inventory, virtual networks, effective routes, security groups, pod readiness, workspaces and recorded infrastructure state, with practical investigation cases.

- [AWS EC2 network path inspection](https://packetly.ly/sheets/aws-ec2-network-path-inspection/): Connect AWS identity, instance state, subnets, route tables, security groups and network ACLs in one inspection workflow.
- [Azure subscription and resource inventory](https://packetly.ly/sheets/azure-subscription-and-resource-inventory/): Check CLI context and inventory resources in the intended subscription.
- [Azure virtual network inspection](https://packetly.ly/sheets/azure-virtual-network-inspection/): Inspect virtual networks, subnets and security group inventory.
- [Cloud network fundamentals](https://packetly.ly/sheets/cloud-network-fundamentals/): Connect subnets, routes, security rules, and DNS into one model.
- [Kubernetes cluster DNS service investigation](https://packetly.ly/sheets/kubernetes-cluster-dns-service-investigation/): Inspect the cluster DNS Service, EndpointSlices, DNS pods and logs when workloads cannot resolve names.
- [Kubernetes deployment rollout investigation](https://packetly.ly/sheets/kubernetes-deployment-rollout-investigation/): Inspect deployment rollout status, ReplicaSets, pod readiness and events during a stalled release.
- [Kubernetes persistent volume claim investigation](https://packetly.ly/sheets/kubernetes-persistent-volume-claim-investigation/): Investigate a pending persistent volume claim using claim events, storage classes and bound volumes.
- [Kubernetes pod crash and readiness investigation](https://packetly.ly/sheets/kubernetes-pod-crash-and-readiness-investigation/): Trace a failing pod through context, scheduling, container state, current logs, previous logs and namespace events.
- [Kubernetes service endpoint troubleshooting](https://packetly.ly/sheets/kubernetes-service-endpoint-troubleshooting/): Trace a Service through selectors, pod readiness, EndpointSlices and service ports.
- [Terraform workspace and state inspection](https://packetly.ly/sheets/terraform-workspace-and-state-inspection/): Verify the active workspace, provider requirements, configuration validity and recorded resources before planning infrastructure changes.

### [Cybersecurity cheat sheets](https://packetly.ly/topics/cybersecurity/)

Security inspection references for FortiGate, Sophos and Kali Linux: firewall and cluster health, IPsec tunnels, session and traffic investigation, port discovery and packet analysis.

- [FortiGate CLI essentials](https://packetly.ly/sheets/fortigate-cli-essentials/): The everyday commands for finding your way around a FortiGate.
- [FortiGate HA & system health](https://packetly.ly/sheets/fortigate-ha-system-health/): Check cluster membership and baseline appliance health.
- [FortiGate VPN health](https://packetly.ly/sheets/fortigate-vpn-health/): Inspect IPsec tunnel health and security associations.
- [FortiGate session inspection](https://packetly.ly/sheets/fortigate-session-inspection/): Connect policy decisions with live traffic sessions.
- [Kali Burp Suite proxy basics](https://packetly.ly/sheets/kali-burp-suite-proxy-basics/): Inspect requests from a local training application with Burp’s built-in browser.
- [Kali Nmap discovery essentials](https://packetly.ly/sheets/kali-nmap-discovery-essentials/): Discover a lab host’s exposed TCP services and interpret scan states.
- [Kali Wireshark packet analysis](https://packetly.ly/sheets/kali-wireshark-packet-analysis/): Use display filters to inspect DNS, TCP handshakes and one lab conversation.
- [OpenSSH client connection investigation](https://packetly.ly/sheets/openssh-client-connection-investigation/): Inspect OpenSSH client configuration, host keys and verbose connection stages without weakening host verification.
- [Sophos Firewall CLI health checks](https://packetly.ly/sheets/sophos-firewall-cli-health-checks/): Gather appliance version, uptime and resource diagnostics in Device Console.
- [Sophos Firewall traffic investigation](https://packetly.ly/sheets/sophos-firewall-traffic-investigation/): Use log filters to connect a connection failure with firewall decisions.
- [TLS certificate inspection with OpenSSL](https://packetly.ly/sheets/tls-certificate-inspection-with-openssl/): Inspect the presented TLS certificate, hostname validation and certificate expiration using OpenSSL.
- [Windows certificate store inspection](https://packetly.ly/sheets/windows-certificate-store-inspection/): Inspect certificate stores, expiration dates and thumbprints when investigating a Windows service certificate.
- [Windows firewall policy inspection](https://packetly.ly/sheets/windows-firewall-policy-inspection/): Inspect active Windows firewall profiles, rules and port filters when investigating a blocked connection.

### [IT fundamentals cheat sheets](https://packetly.ly/topics/it-fundamentals/)

Everyday troubleshooting references for Windows and Linux hosts: addressing, DNS resolution, TCP reachability, systemd services, journals, event logs, time synchronization, Git changes and listening sockets.

- [Git branch and upstream tracking inspection](https://packetly.ly/sheets/git-branch-and-upstream-tracking-inspection/): Inspect the current branch, upstream tracking and local commit differences before synchronizing a repository.
- [Git working tree and merge conflict inspection](https://packetly.ly/sheets/git-working-tree-and-merge-conflict-inspection/): Separate staged, unstaged, untracked and conflicted files before choosing a commit or recovery action.
- [Linux network essentials](https://packetly.ly/sheets/linux-network-essentials/): A small toolkit for inspecting a Linux host’s network.
- [Linux system clock synchronization inspection](https://packetly.ly/sheets/linux-system-clock-synchronization-inspection/): Inspect system time, synchronization status and the time service on a systemd-based Linux host.
- [Linux systemd service failure triage](https://packetly.ly/sheets/linux-systemd-service-failure-triage/): Connect service state, exit codes, unit configuration and journal events without hiding evidence behind a restart.
- [Windows DNS resolution investigation](https://packetly.ly/sheets/windows-dns-resolution-investigation/): Separate resolver selection, stale cache, missing records and service reachability in a Windows DNS incident.
- [Windows TCP listener and process investigation](https://packetly.ly/sheets/windows-tcp-listener-and-process-investigation/): Map a TCP listener to its owning process and compare local binding with a remote connectivity test.
- [Windows network troubleshooting](https://packetly.ly/sheets/windows-network-troubleshooting/): Inspect addressing, DNS resolution and TCP reachability with PowerShell.
- [Windows services and event logs](https://packetly.ly/sheets/windows-services-and-event-logs/): Build a focused picture of service state and recent system errors.
- [Windows time synchronization investigation](https://packetly.ly/sheets/windows-time-synchronization-investigation/): Inspect time source, synchronization status, peer configuration and measured offset before forcing a clock change.

### [Identity & Microsoft 365 cheat sheets](https://packetly.ly/topics/identity-microsoft-365/)

Identity and Microsoft 365 references for Active Directory, Entra ID, Microsoft Graph and Exchange Online: users and groups, replication health, sign-in investigation, mailboxes, message tracing and Group Policy application.

- [Active Directory domain controller discovery](https://packetly.ly/sheets/active-directory-domain-controller-discovery/): Inspect domain controller discovery, DNS service records and site selection from a Windows client.
- [Active Directory replication health](https://packetly.ly/sheets/active-directory-replication-health/): Compare domain-controller replication and locate recent failures.
- [Active Directory users and groups](https://packetly.ly/sheets/active-directory-users-and-groups/): Inspect domain identity, user status and group membership using RSAT.
- [Entra ID devices and tenant overview](https://packetly.ly/sheets/entra-id-devices-and-tenant-overview/): Inspect tenant context, device identities and join state without changing access.
- [Entra ID sign-in investigation](https://packetly.ly/sheets/entra-id-sign-in-investigation/): Review recent sign-ins and distinguish authentication from policy failures.
- [Exchange Online mailbox inspection](https://packetly.ly/sheets/exchange-online-mailbox-inspection/): Connect to Exchange Online and review mailbox identity and quotas.
- [Exchange Online message tracing](https://packetly.ly/sheets/exchange-online-message-tracing/): Trace a recent sender and examine the events for a specific message.
- [Microsoft Graph connection and user lookup](https://packetly.ly/sheets/microsoft-graph-connection-and-user-lookup/): Connect to the correct tenant and inspect directory user records.
- [Microsoft Graph query and paging basics](https://packetly.ly/sheets/microsoft-graph-query-and-paging-basics/): Find users with server-side filters and handle complete result sets.
- [Windows Group Policy application investigation](https://packetly.ly/sheets/windows-group-policy-application-investigation/): Compare endpoint policy results, processing events, domain GPO inventory, OU inheritance and configured settings.

### [Infrastructure cheat sheets](https://packetly.ly/topics/infrastructure/)

Infrastructure references for servers, storage, databases and automation: HPE and Dell health, Linux capacity, Windows DHCP and SMB, Docker, Ansible, Redis, PostgreSQL and MySQL investigations.

- [Ansible inventory and playbook preflight](https://packetly.ly/sheets/ansible-inventory-and-playbook-preflight/): Check configuration, inventory groups, resolved host variables and selected playbook hosts before running automation.
- [Dell Data Domain capacity and health](https://packetly.ly/sheets/dell-data-domain-capacity-and-health/): Inspect filesystem state, capacity and active protection-appliance alerts.
- [Dell Data Domain replication checks](https://packetly.ly/sheets/dell-data-domain-replication-checks/): Inspect replication contexts and distinguish idle replication from a stalled copy.
- [Dell PowerEdge hardware inventory](https://packetly.ly/sheets/dell-poweredge-hardware-inventory/): Capture firmware and hardware inventory before planning maintenance.
- [Dell PowerEdge iDRAC health checks](https://packetly.ly/sheets/dell-poweredge-idrac-health-checks/): Read PowerEdge identity, power state and hardware event history.
- [Docker Compose service state investigation](https://packetly.ly/sheets/docker-compose-service-state-investigation/): Inspect the effective Compose service model, container state and recent service logs.
- [Docker container health and restart investigation](https://packetly.ly/sheets/docker-container-health-and-restart-investigation/): Inspect container exit state, health checks, bounded logs, resource usage and published ports during a restart incident.
- [Docker network connectivity inspection](https://packetly.ly/sheets/docker-network-connectivity-inspection/): Inspect container network membership, addressing, port publication and bounded application logs.
- [Docker volume mount inspection](https://packetly.ly/sheets/docker-volume-mount-inspection/): Trace a container mount to its Docker volume and inspect its driver and attachment.
- [HPE ProLiant iLO health overview](https://packetly.ly/sheets/hpe-proliant-ilo-health-overview/): Read ProLiant health and hardware events through iLO.
- [Linux disk space and inode investigation](https://packetly.ly/sheets/linux-disk-space-and-inode-investigation/): Distinguish exhausted bytes, exhausted inodes, mount layout and directory growth before deleting any files.
- [Linux memory pressure investigation](https://packetly.ly/sheets/linux-memory-pressure-investigation/): Compare available memory, swap, process usage and kernel messages when a Linux host slows down.
- [Linux systemd timer troubleshooting](https://packetly.ly/sheets/linux-systemd-timer-troubleshooting/): Inspect timer schedules, unit settings and service results when scheduled work does not run.
- [MySQL connection and InnoDB lock investigation](https://packetly.ly/sheets/mysql-connection-and-innodb-lock-investigation/): Inspect MySQL identity, connection saturation, running sessions, active InnoDB transactions and lock dependencies.
- [PostgreSQL session and blocking investigation](https://packetly.ly/sheets/postgresql-session-and-blocking-investigation/): Inspect database identity, connection counts, wait events, blocking relationships and long transactions using bounded SQL queries.
- [Redis memory and latency investigation](https://packetly.ly/sheets/redis-memory-and-latency-investigation/): Compare Redis identity, memory pressure, eviction counters, client connections and slow-command evidence without scanning the keyspace.
- [VCF 9 ESXi host root password recovery](https://packetly.ly/sheets/vcf-9-esxi-host-root-password-recovery/): Recover a managed ESXi host root account through vCenter and PowerCLI, and reconcile VCF credential management.
- [VCF 9 ESXi monitoring and troubleshooting commands](https://packetly.ly/sheets/vcf-9-esxi-monitoring-and-troubleshooting-commands/): Inspect ESXi 9 identity, resources, networking, storage and time when investigating a VCF workload issue.
- [VCF 9 license server deployment and registration](https://packetly.ly/sheets/vcf-9-license-server-deployment-and-registration/): Plan and verify the dedicated VCF License Server deployment and registration for VCF 9.1.
- [VCF 9 vCenter appliance root password recovery](https://packetly.ly/sheets/vcf-9-vcenter-appliance-root-password-recovery/): Reset a forgotten vCenter Server Appliance root password through an authorized SSO administrator and reconcile the VCF credential.
- [Windows DHCP scope and lease investigation](https://packetly.ly/sheets/windows-dhcp-scope-and-lease-investigation/): Inspect DHCP scope capacity, leases, reservations, options and failover before changing a production scope.
- [Windows SMB share access investigation](https://packetly.ly/sheets/windows-smb-share-access-investigation/): Separate TCP reachability, client SMB connections, share permissions, filesystem ACLs and server-side sessions.

### [Networking cheat sheets](https://packetly.ly/topics/networking/)

Network references for Cisco, Juniper, FortiGate, HPE Aruba, Ubiquiti, curl and NGINX: interfaces, VLANs, routes, neighbors, ARP, HTTP redirects, TLS certificates and reverse-proxy upstream investigation.

- [Cisco IOS essentials](https://packetly.ly/sheets/cisco-ios-essentials/): Get oriented, inspect interfaces, and understand your device.
- [Cisco VLANs & trunks](https://packetly.ly/sheets/cisco-vlans-trunks/): Understand access VLANs, tagged links, and Layer 2 boundaries.
- [Cisco interface diagnostics](https://packetly.ly/sheets/cisco-interface-diagnostics/): Find link failures and read the counters that matter.
- [Cisco neighbor discovery](https://packetly.ly/sheets/cisco-neighbor-discovery/): Map the devices directly connected to your switch.
- [Cisco routing basics](https://packetly.ly/sheets/cisco-routing-basics/): Read connected, static, and learned routes with confidence.
- [DNS record investigation with dig](https://packetly.ly/sheets/dns-record-investigation-with-dig/): Compare DNS answers, authoritative servers, response codes and TCP fallback using dig.
- [FortiGate routing & ARP](https://packetly.ly/sheets/fortigate-routing-arp/): Follow a packet from its next hop to the routing table.
- [HPE Aruba CX switching essentials](https://packetly.ly/sheets/hpe-aruba-cx-switching-essentials/): Inspect AOS-CX switch interfaces and VLANs with platform-specific commands.
- [HTTP and TLS troubleshooting with curl](https://packetly.ly/sheets/http-and-tls-troubleshooting-with-curl/): Separate DNS, TCP, certificate validation, redirects and HTTP status with bounded curl requests.
- [Juniper Junos CLI essentials](https://packetly.ly/sheets/juniper-junos-cli-essentials/): Get oriented in Junos operational mode and inspect the chassis.
- [Juniper routes and neighbor checks](https://packetly.ly/sheets/juniper-routes-and-neighbor-checks/): Inspect routes, ARP entries and discovered neighbors in Junos.
- [Linux IPv6 host path inspection](https://packetly.ly/sheets/linux-ipv6-host-path-inspection/): Inspect IPv6 addresses, route selection, neighbors and listeners on a Linux host.
- [NGINX reverse proxy upstream investigation](https://packetly.ly/sheets/nginx-reverse-proxy-upstream-investigation/): Connect configuration tests, service logs, listener state and direct upstream requests during a reverse-proxy outage.
- [Ubiquiti UniFi USW Layer 3 discovery and adoption](https://packetly.ly/sheets/ubiquiti-unifi-usw-layer-3-discovery-and-adoption/): Discover and adopt a UniFi USW switch when the UniFi Network application is on another subnet or site.
- [Ubiquiti UniFi device connectivity](https://packetly.ly/sheets/ubiquiti-unifi-device-connectivity/): Follow adoption and management connectivity through the UniFi console.
- [Ubiquiti UniFi switch port checks](https://packetly.ly/sheets/ubiquiti-unifi-switch-port-checks/): Inspect switch port state, VLAN assignment and PoE budget.
- [Windows route selection and VPN troubleshooting](https://packetly.ly/sheets/windows-route-selection-and-vpn-troubleshooting/): Inspect route selection, interface metrics and the source path for a destination on a Windows host.
